I wrote the profile settings form to `./solution.tsx`. I couldn't run it, so it hasn't been rendered or tested.

- **Display name:** a text field with the hint "Shown to your crew." linked to it for screen readers.
- **Time zone:** a select with UTC, Berlin and Tokyo, and the placeholder "Choose a time zone".
- **Email me about new orbits:** a switch. Its label is clickable, so the whole 44px row toggles it.
- **Save profile:** a primary submit button. Submitting shows "Profile saved." in a status line. Editing any field afterwards clears that message.
- **Brand:** it uses only the workspace's shadcn components and the Tailwind theme colours that follow `brand.css`, so it should follow all three brands. I didn't hard-code any colours. The inputs, select, options, button and switch row all
